integrity: The claim is analytically proved using the qubit minimum-enclosing-ball dual and regular-tetrahedron tight-frame identity. The finite Python tests corroborate but do not certify an infinite-domain claim. No priority or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only four equal-prior tetrahedral pure qubit preparations, arbitrary single qubit CPTP channel, common input unitary, unconstrained decoder POVM. Minimization is the worst input orientation, not maximum performance. Does not address unequal priors, multi-copy collective measurements, or channel uncertainty.
title: Worst-orientation qubit tetrahedral discrimination obeys a Frobenius-norm law
